findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "research" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "clean_data" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Clean a messy spreadsheet or JSON export into typed, deduplicated records with a log of each change. Use it when a spreadsheet or export needs cleaning or dedup…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: research, clean_data · Private data: transcribe, research, clean_data · Public sink: clean_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: research, clean_data · Private data: transcribe, research, clean_data · Public sink: clean_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "transcribe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
